title: Rust stale authenticated SCHC contexts can remint current fragmentation permits
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext is a Copy standalone value derived from any old AuthenticatedFrame, and FragmentationPolicy::accept_peer accepts it repeatedly based only on embedded signer/version. After policy replacement/removal or link key rotation, a caller can resubmit old evidence and mint a new-generation permit, defeating revocation. Make contexts current owner-issued capabilities bound to receiving LinkLayer key generation/liveness, and make policy admission validate that issuance atomically. Old, foreign, removed, rekeyed, and copied stale contexts must not mint permits; add recovery and capacity tests.
